chat.author: Cullen Jennings
chat.text: starting Aug 10 meeting

chat.author: Ian Swett
chat.text: Unfiltered sgtm

chat.author: Martin Duke
chat.text: That seems reasonable and intuitive

chat.author: Martin Duke
chat.text: Is there a use case for disjoint filters?

chat.author: Ian Swett
chat.text: I don't like the complexity, so it might be worth going through use cases?

chat.author: Ian Swett
chat.text: You can always issues a separate fetch from Subscribe

chat.author: Suhas Nandakumar
chat.text: that would be fine, however that defeats the purpose on why joining fetch was proposed though .. to have seamlessly join and not also have addiotional rtt to decide the fetch

chat.author: Ian Swett
chat.text: We should probably go with two filters for now, we could propose a follow up later.

chat.author: Cullen Jennings
chat.text: so if live locaion is group 2, and I ask to go 5 back, that is not an errror, I jiust get from start ?

chat.author: Martin Duke
chat.text: It should start at UINT64_MAX - 3 :-)

chat.author: Cullen Jennings
chat.text: +1 on Alan proposal for #3.

chat.author: Ian Swett
chat.text: What if we remove Forward?  Suhas PR

chat.author: Ian Swett
chat.text: At least we now know if the Object isn't present because the fetch failed upstream

chat.author: Ian Swett
chat.text: Fat finger

chat.author: Ian Swett
chat.text: If you nest all the fetch params, maybe we can update the fetch subscriber priority

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: Track properties/parameters should be immutable IMO.

chat.author: Ian Swett
chat.text: Track properties are immutable, but Priority is different

chat.author: Martin Duke
chat.text: The pub priority of any object/subgroup is immutable, so I don't like creating uncertainty about the PP with this scheme

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: ples no synchronization to save a byte, or make object priority ambiguous

chat.author: Martin Duke
chat.text: I don't see how you avoid a relay with two upstreams getting different priorities for the same object

chat.author: Suhas Nandakumar
chat.text: +1 to Luke ..

chat.author: Suhas Nandakumar
chat.text: dont bother remove all raciness

chat.author: Martin Duke
chat.text: I really don't see how you remove all raciness

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: we'll need something like QPACK if you want to allow changing this dynamically

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: and updating track properties/parameters in general

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: draft-frindell-moqpack

chat.author: Michal Hošna
chat.text: Having this "compression" as a track property (i.e. end-to-end) seems kinda weird.

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: facepalm

chat.author: Suhas Nandakumar
chat.text: hahaa

chat.author: Suhas Nandakumar
chat.text: @alan you paced too fast

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: we do for FetCH but not fill-fetch :/

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: scone rates apply over 67s fwiw

chat.author: Mo Zanaty
chat.text: Can't a client already do this today without server help simply using QUIC MAX_STREAM_DATA? So it's a local API issue?

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: This is per request, not per connection?

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: yes per fetch

chat.author: Martin Duke
chat.text: we have an official MoQ API?

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: heckno

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: So this is the rate at which you can queue up data to a stream? What happens during congestion?

chat.author: Ali Begen
chat.text: data trasnfer will get slower

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: ex. go through a tunnel for 10s, do we burst 10s of paced data after recovery?

chat.author: Suhas Nandakumar
chat.text: may be we timeout fetch reqest by then

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: I'm neutral on where it lives

chat.author: Suhas Nandakumar
chat.text: we need to careful on how we add scone depedency though ..

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: seems like a soft dep ?  I haven't read

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: so the pacing is optional?

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: like the relay can ignore this parameter for slow consumers?

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: (wife is asleep can't talk)

chat.author: Michal Hošna
chat.text: I think this needs to be optional for relays.

chat.author: Suhas Nandakumar
chat.text: it is in SETUP message for now

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: as written it's optional

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: but if you accept the param, i think you ought to pace

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: I think sender controlled pacing is better than cramming the pipe until it fills and then draining slowly

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: I think this pacing is intended for one FETCH 0-∞ for the entire VOD, but I worry about pacing too fast or too slow

chat.author: Mo Zanaty
chat.text: Alan, I disagree, this is literally what flow control means. It's not limited to memory resources.

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: therein lies madness, explicit singals preferred

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: and I also would never use this for FETCH 0-∞ because we want to fill the playback buffer (ex. 30s) as fast as possible

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: instead of trickling vod data frame by frame

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: if you want as fast as possible it

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: s not for you

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: we use it for vod prefetch

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: Alan how? would you FETCH the first 2s as fast as possible? or do you fetch the first 10s with pacing?

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: (or first 2s with pacing?)

chat.author: Martin Duke
chat.text: How does this interact with FORWARD in PUBLISH_NOTIFY?

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: filters are optional

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: Location filter isn't

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: heh sorry I missed that rename

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: and just to clarify, when you "resume" a subscription with both of these mechanisms, it's next object?

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: not latest group or something?

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: but yeah I would get rid of forward, I think it's better to explicitly state start/end locations like Mo says

chat.author: Martin Duke
chat.text: unless there's some sort of DoS

chat.author: Will Law
chat.text: We have the path with unlimited depth, so don;t need query

chat.author: Will Law
chat.text: Can draft 20 have alphabetical listing of messages :)
